svg.text: Links of the same TF are connected
to its maximum spanning tree, which
node: e^(s − γ) for link, 1 otherwise
edge: e^(λw) if both agree, 1 otherwise
Exact belief propagation on each tree.
A link is kept if P(link) > 0.5;
links scoring above α stay fixed.
max F(γ, λ): precision on gold
links predicted by more than half
Open standard: works with any MCP client, e.g. Claude Code
